chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade spitting in the direction of the Qiblah.

key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicated a prohibition or disapproval
key_terms.ٱلْقِبْلَةِ: the Qiblah; the direction faced in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about spitting toward the Qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prohibited spitting toward the Qiblah. It indicates the sanctity of the Qiblah and the importance of proper etiquette in matters connected to worship.
